name: Menu
description: A navigation list in a nav landmark: links with icons and badges, section titles, separators and collapsible sub-menus, with the current page marked. Not for actions; use DropdownMenu.

livewire.name: menu
capabilities: Children: menu-item, menu-sub, menu-title and menu-separator; items renders the same children
menu-item takes route and activates by the current URL (activate-by-route on the menu or the item)

react.name: Menu
capabilities: Children: MenuItem, MenuSub, MenuTitle and MenuSeparator; items renders the same children

vue.name: Menu
capabilities: Children: MenuItem, MenuSub, MenuTitle and MenuSeparator; items renders the same children

props.name: items
props.description: The menu as data, rendering the same children as composition: { label, href, icon, badge, current, disabled }, { label, icon, open, items: [...] } for a sub-menu, { type: 'title', label } and { type: 'separator' }.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Sub-menus open and close from their item, a button with aria-expanded. Off shows every sub-menu, with its item as a plain heading. Emitted as data-collapsible.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the nav landmark, such as Main or Settings.
props.a11y: Name every Menu when a page has more than one nav landmark.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { item: '…', sub: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The nav landmark, carrying the root class.

parts.name: item
parts.description: A link (aria-current=page when it's the current page), a sub-menu's toggle button, or a sub-menu's heading when collapsible is off.

parts.name: badge
parts.description: An item's count or status, at the end of the item.

parts.name: chevron
parts.description: A sub-menu toggle's chevron. It points to the inline end and turns down while open; it mirrors in RTL.

parts.name: sub
parts.description: A sub-menu's list, hidden while it's closed.

parts.name: separator
parts.description: A rule between items, hidden from assistive technology.

keyboard.action: Move through the links and sub-menu toggles in order. Items in a closed sub-menu are skipped.
Follows a link; opens or closes a sub-menu.

requirements: A nav landmark, named with label when the page has more than one.
The current page's item sets aria-current=page; it is shown by surface and color, not color alone.
A sub-menu's item is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its list (the disclosure pattern); it is not an ARIA menu, so the arrow keys aren't used.
A sub-menu holding the current page renders open.
Disabled links set aria-disabled, lose their href and leave the Tab order.
Titles and badges are text, so screen readers read them in order; separators are aria-hidden.
The chevron mirrors in RTL and is aria-hidden; the button's expanded state carries the meaning.
Every toggle and sub-menu keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).
